notes.title: I SPIT ON OLDER VERSIONS OF THIS GAME - THIS IS THE BEST VERSION
notes.notes:
INTRODUCING : MOFO'in CHECK POINTS BOYEE!!!!!!!!!!

Why is this a big deal? No more frusterating start overs every 20 seconds. And now, in this version I can afford to make every 20 seconds until the checkpoint EXCITING. Because I don't have to worry about killing you and make you walk 90 seconds back. This keeps the pace up! Because now I can go balls to the walls and throw enemies at you. The game is SO MUCH BETTER, and more balanced now. Way less frusterating. The other versions of this game pale in comparison - I think this is a an EXCELLENT update and probably the biggest one since I added character selections and you can be parodies of public figures. Yeah, it's that BIG of a deal. Try it out, And leave a review, let me know what you think now the game has improved so much.

notes.title: THIS IS THE "PERFORMANCE" UPDATE
notes.notes:
The game no longer requires Vulkan. So lower end pcs even MOBILE (coming very soon) is now possible to play it. 
I also optimized performance in several other ways. ENJOY.

notes.title: Biggest Update?
notes.notes:
So much changed, 
New hitboxes making it impossible to hit enemies from other floors preventing accidental deaths, new abilities, new playable characters. Bug fixes. I'd start over at the tutorial. Things have come a long way. Tell me what you think!

notes.title: GORE UPDATE & SOME ENEMIES HAVE DEATH LINES NOW
Quality of Life Improvements To Free Skull Stompers Version
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS LIST TO LATEST BUILD (ASK ME TO PLAY IT, IT IS NOT ON STEAM!)
*Added visible shields to enemies with more then one hit so you can visually see how many hits each enemy takes
*Low amount of jumps remaining warning system, with 3 distinctive warnings, one for 1 jump left, one for 0 jumps left and a dinging sound, and if you press it when your out of jumps it will remind you "You are out of jumps!" while beeping at you everytime you press the button. Great addition.
*Added shaman enemy that spawns little devils
*Teeth from roof of worm now kill (Much requested)
*Poops are now not direct homing missiles that can turn on a dime, they are slow, dumb tracking, they will lose you easily and veer off the wrong path - making them easier to lose and easier to deal with. 
*Poops have a stink trail now making them much easier to spot
*Poops now make a sound when on screen, so you'll always know when there is one sneaking up on you soon
*Intro now references the furries being mind controlled - earlier it did not - this was only referenced before in the voice by Ben Shapiro and the store page. Now it's part of the story for reals.
LIKE THESE CHANGES? 
Gold edition is even better..
